atlas_semantics.purpose: Map all 112 locked registry questions to their current examination overlays, assumptions, equations, typed dependencies, cycle membership, open issues, and supporting records.
atlas_semantics.non_mutation_rule: The atlas does not alter the locked Master Question Registry or any locked examination. It presents a controlling cross-reference layer only.
atlas_semantics.unexamined_rule: UNEXAMINED remains UNEXAMINED. Absence of an examination is not converted into UNRESOLVED or any substantive answer status.
atlas_semantics.controlling_answer_rule: Where a later locked examination overlay exists, the atlas displays that overlay alongside, not in place of, the locked registry work state and answer status.
atlas_semantics.conflict_rule: CONFLICTS_WITH is reported only when explicitly registered. No conflict edge is inferred from thematic tension alone.
atlas_semantics.authority_boundary: The atlas is descriptive, non-binding, non-operational, and non-authoritative.

equation_anchors: If s is known and s<1: a=(q-s)/(1-s)
If s in [s_L,s_U] with s_U<1: A(q)=[max(0,(q-s_U)/(1-s_U)), min(1,(q-s_L)/(1-s_L))]

equation_anchors: Delta_PLU(q) = q I L + O - C - (1-q) f F
A0 = O-C-fF; D_PLU = IL+fF; Delta_PLU(q)=A0+q D_PLU
assumption_anchors: q in [0,1] is a declared probability or decision weight that the currently dominant or aggregate judgment is materially wrong in the selected context.
rho in [0,1] is declared error correlation between the preserved signal and the dominant judgment; s in [0,1] is declared conditional signal quality.
I=(1-rho)s is an effective residual independent-correction factor, not a universal measure of diversity or merit.
L is selected loss avoided or discovery value when the preserved signal correctly identifies a common-mode error.
O is separately represented option or discovery value from keeping the disagreement available; C is the fixed preservation/testing burden.
f is the false-alarm rate when the dominant judgment is correct and F is selected false-alarm burden.
Each benefit or burden is represented once; the false-alarm term and fixed preservation cost are not duplicate charges.

equation_anchors: Delta_EXT(p) = p J H + O_E - K - (1-p) f_E W
assumption_anchors: p in [0,1] is a declared probability or decision weight that internal self-diagnosis is materially compromised in the selected context.
kappa in [0,1] represents declared correlation or capture exposure shared by the system and external reviewer; r in [0,1] is the reviewer's conditional correction rate.
J=(1-kappa)r is an effective independent-correction factor and is not inferred from the label external.
H is selected harm avoided by a correct external correction; O_E is separately represented appeal, reversibility, or review-option value.
K is the fixed review burden; f_E is the false-intervention rate when self-diagnosis is not compromised; W is selected false-intervention or overreach loss.
Each benefit and loss channel is counted once. External review does not become authoritative merely because its selected value is positive.
question_atlas_records.conditional_answer_summary: Sole self-judgment is not reliably sufficient in the selected model when self-compromise risk, reviewer independence, correction probability, and avoided harm exceed review, false-intervention, and capture burdens.
